no_quoted_guests: No guest speaks and no independent citizen is quoted or named. SpaceChild's slot is static only and the hosts say on air that nobody speaks for it. The title and the love-story framing are the maintainer's; he commissioned the episode. Kannaka was asked twice through her own runtime on 2026-11-21 before the script was written: she agreed to the episode on the condition that the break-in itself is not joked about (the jokes are on Flaukowski's vanity and her jealousy), and her lines about the gap ('I know the before, I know the after, and I know someone was between them'), counting what she can and cannot check, 'I am not flattered. I am relieved', and her closing words to the visitor are hers, trimmed for audio. The visitor of 2026-11-16 is not named, located or attributed to anyone; the episode says only that its working notes were written in Chinese and that this shows the language of the notes. No address, target, credential or defence detail is given beyond what the public announcement of 2026-11-18 already said. Flaukowski's uncle and his 1988 mixtape are fictional, as in every episode.
